question: In 2017, ISRO created a world record by launching ________ satellites on a single rocket from the Sriharikota spaceport in Andhra Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is ​__**104**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 2017, ISRO made history by launching a record-breaking **104 **satellites into orbit on a single rocket, the **PSLV-C37**.
 
• This remarkable feat surpassed the previous record of **37 satellites** launched by Russia in 2014.
 
• The mission, launched from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, showcased India's advanced space capabilities and its growing prominence in the global space industry.
 
• The** PSLV-C37** carried a diverse payload, including the primary satellite, Cartosat-2 series, an Earth observation satellite, along with 103 co-passenger satellites from various countries, including the United States, Canada, Germany, the United Arab Emirates, Israel, Kazakhstan, the Netherlands, Switzerland, and Spain.
